title: The Colossal Squid Has Eyes the Size of Dinner Plates

scenes.text: The colossal squid has the biggest eyes of any animal on Earth.
About eleven inches across, wider than a dinner plate.
Even its lens is around twelve centimeters wide.
Researchers found the eyes can spot the faint glow of plankton lit up by a sperm whale swimming near.
That's an early warning for its deadliest enemy.
Eyes built to see a whale coming.

description:
The colossal squid has the largest eyes of any known animal, about 11 inches across.
A 2012 study found they help it spot the glow of plankton disturbed by sperm whales, its main predator.
What is the biggest sea creature you want to see?
